verdict.rationale: Reducto's own docs describe enterprise deployment options: a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model, and air-gapped deployment. These indicate the core product can run in customer infrastructure. The evidence is thin and enterprise-gated, and the documented hybrid model still runs processing on Reducto's GPU infrastructure. missing for 10: self-serve self-hosting documentation (install/setup guides, system requirements), availability outside enterprise contracts, detail on the fully on-prem/air-gapped deployment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Customers can choose between a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model, and a fully hosted SaaS model
All data and storage reside in the customer’s VPC, while ephemeral processing is handled by Reducto’s dedicated GPU infrastructure.
